criteria.notes: The app proves opt-in video playback, playlist, captions, recovery, telemetry, and controls.
The brief is creatively directed and does not specify an external visual reference.
The fictional Lumen broadcast identity and full-bleed program composition are specific to media playback.
Primary program titles, active source, and status remain above declared room-view font floors.
Dark, Light, and Custom palettes keep every app-owned overlay and native caption readable.
Long venue, program, and source names fit or ellipsize without clipping or geometry changes.
Media remains dominant while playlist and progress chrome reflow deliberately on all required surfaces.
Packaged synthetic WebM assets, generated icon, placeholder, and coordinated palettes render correctly.
The broadcast-style full-bleed program differs materially from dashboard and card-based examples.

screenshots.notes: Full HD program is balanced, readable, and fully populated.

Landscape layout keeps media dominant and labels bounded.
Portrait layout repositions the source rail above the footer.
Compact behavior scenario remains readable without overlap.
Custom palette updates the complete authored chrome coherently.
Full HD scenario shows active playback, playlist, caption, and progress.
Pathological labels truncate cleanly above semantic font floors.
Light portrait chrome, caption, source rail, and footer retain contrast.
Recovery scenario advances to playable media and shows the active source.
Square layout preserves video, caption, identity, and progress.
